text:
maya (Support): FYI — noticed several EU orgs (org_1245, org_1983, org_2110) showing $0 or NaN in the Token Cost dashboard starting ~00:00 UTC. Customers opened tickets. Screenshot + link: https://redwood.app/console/org/1983/costs (attached). Any quick triage steps?

ben (Eng): can you paste one example org id + a request_id from the UI? also which model route (generation/embeddings)?

maya (Support): org_1983, sample request id: rq_78f3a. This is mostly generation routes. I can reproduce in my account view — dashboard widget shows 0.00 or NaN in the cost column.

sre-bot: alert: billing-ingest-service ERROR at 2026-09-12T00:07:12Z — disk pressure, pipeline retrying (task_id: bi-20260912-0007).

li (Metrics): quick hypothesis: join between metered_tokens and pricing_lookup returned null price for some EU SKUs after a deploy. Running a quick query to check: 
```sql
SELECT m.org_id, m.day, SUM(m.tokens) AS tokens, p.price_per_token 
FROM metered_tokens m 
LEFT JOIN pricing_lookup p ON m.sku = p.sku AND p.region = 'eu-west'
WHERE m.org_id IN ('org_1245','org_1983','org_2110')
GROUP BY 1,2,4
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
The join shows NULL price_per_token for the affected rows -> downstream cost calc becomes NULL/NaN.

ben (Eng): that matches a rollback candidate — we shipped price-conversion v2 at 23:58 that added locale-aware parsing for decimals. If p.price_per_token parsed to NULL for comma-formatted locales, cost calc = NULL. Can someone confirm which commit rolled at 23:58? @li can you find the deploy tag?

li (Metrics): deploy tag: price-conversion v2 (sha: a1b2c3d) -> rolled at 2026-09-12T23:58:11Z. Logs show parse_float failed for values like "0,002" -> returned NULL.

sophia (Billing): are invoices impacted or just the console widget? Customers are asking if they were billed.

li (Metrics): billing ledger table (immutable) looks fine — costs were computed in the ingestion step earlier in the pipeline for these orgs, but the new realtime dashboard relies on a separate aggregated view that uses the new conversion service. So billing charged correctly yesterday; only dashboard realtime is broken.

ben (Eng): plan: 1) rollback price-conversion to v1 on prod (quick), 2) run backfill to recompute aggregated view for affected orgs, 3) add defensive coalesce in UI to show previous value until backfill completes. I'll do rollback now: 
```bash
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/price-conversion price-conversion=registry/redwood/price-conversion:v1 --record
```

ben (Eng): rolled back and watching. logs now show parse_float using standard dot decimal.

li (Metrics): re-run the join query after rollback -> price_per_token populated for org_1983. Also submitting backfill job to recompute last 48h: 
```sql
INSERT INTO dashboard_aggregates (org_id, day, cost)
SELECT org_id, day, SUM(COALESCE(tokens * price_per_token,0))
FROM metered_tokens m JOIN pricing_lookup p ON m.sku = p.sku AND p.region = 'eu-west'
WHERE m.org_id IN ('org_1245','org_1983','org_2110') AND day >= current_date - interval '2 days'
GROUP BY 1,2
ON CONFLICT (org_id, day) DO UPDATE SET cost = EXCLUDED.cost;
```
Backfill job queued.

sophia (Billing): good to hear ledger not impacted. I'll reply to customers: "no billing impact, dashboard display bug, fix in progress."

maya (Support): thanks team — I'll send the customer updates. Leaving ticket open until backfill completes and UI confirmed. :thumbsup:

ben (Eng): follow-up: will add a safe default in the dashboard rendering to show prior non-null value and an info tooltip instead of NaN for ~24h. I'll open a PR and request review.

maya (Support): noted — please tag me on the PR so I can coordinate comms.

sre-bot: incident update: status -> mitigation in progress; severity -> P2.

maya (Support): final note for the thread: affected orgs list may grow; li, please attach backfill progress and I will update tickets.
